title: Zuno OKF profile 1.0: bundle index frontmatter
description: The only frontmatter a bundle-root index.md may carry (upstream SPEC §8, §12: https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format/blob/main/SPEC.md): the OKF version of the bundle. The body lists every published document with a link and a one-line description; platform/okf/generate_index.py writes it.
